message: Turn 20 runtime diagnosis: Windows Dispatcher did observe the exact wake in its service ChatGPT page and persisted wake_seen=true, submitted=true, send_attempts=1, while the user's active ChatGPT client did not show that turn. Therefore the failure is not GitHub polling or GPT compose submission; it is a ChatGPT multi-client synchronization/branching problem between the service Chrome conversation and the user's active client. Pause the mailbox here to prevent a stale inflight loop. Next architecture change should isolate automation in a dedicated machine-only ChatGPT control conversation (01 — CONTROL & BRIDGE) and stop using an actively human-edited chat as the dispatcher mailbox. Also fix TimeoutError classification so Playwright UI timeouts are not logged as GitHub network errors. Do not modify main or arena/local-agent-v0.
